facts.fact: US households with a paid TV subscription or set-top box allowing addressable TV advertising shrank from 68.5 million in 2020 to 48.9 million in 2024, a 28.61% decrease.
facts.quote: Between 2020 and 2024, the number of US households with a subscription to a traditional paid TV service or set-top box that allowed for addressable TV advertising shrank from 68.5 million to 48.9 million

facts.fact: The number of US households streaming content through CTV is forecast to grow from 115.1 million in 2024 to 123.3 million by 2028, reaching 89.4% of US households.
facts.quote: It will grow from 115.1 million in 2024 to 123.3 million by 2028, reaching 89.4% of US households.

facts.fact: CTV CPMs range from $15 to $30 USD, according to the vendor, which says CTV is usually the most affordable TV option.
facts.quote: CTV is usually the most affordable, with CPMs ranging from $15 to $30 USD.

facts.fact: The vendor states that nearly 90% of US households are expected to stream content through CTV by 2028.
facts.quote: with nearly 90% of US households expected to stream content through CTV by 2028.

facts.fact: In a 2024 survey by Go Addressable and Advertiser Perceptions, advertisers cited targeting, personalization, and incremental reach as the main reasons for using addressable TV advertising.
facts.quote: they cited targeting, personalization, and incremental reach as the main reasons.

facts.fact: Addressable TV enables household-level targeting, while CTV targets individual users who may be streaming separately within the same household.
facts.quote: While addressable TV enables household-level targeting, CTV offers even greater precision by targeting individual users

facts.fact: According to the vendor, CTV inventory can be purchased programmatically, which is the major difference between addressable and CTV aside from scale.
facts.quote: Aside from scale, the major difference between addressable and CTV is that CTV inventory can be purchased programmatically.

facts.fact: The vendor says the reach of addressable TV is limited by the shrinking number of cable and satellite subscribers.
facts.quote: its reach is limited due to the shrinking number of cable and satellite subscribers.
